name: test_numeric.py
mathematical_scope: Floating-point sparse-Weyl gap, sparse-inverse error-floor and near-resonance regressions.
input_and_guard_coverage: Selected n,s,t values and numerical tolerances only; no invalid sparsity, singularity, parameter-limit or unstable-scale tests.
costs: Dependency dense norm/inverse operations dominate; numeric regression timing is not a fresh-input complexity count.
test_evidence: 12 methods compare sharp ratios, lower-bound inequalities and condition/defect trends.
acceptance_boundary: Supports finite numerical controls, not exact symbolic bounds or general FFT lower bounds.
findings: L25–29 checks a two-size trend; cannot establish asymptotic conditioning from those two outputs.
